component.name: Bing Wallpaper
component.summary: Bing's image of the day as your wallpaper

description.p: Downloads the Bing image of the day and sets it as the desktop wallpaper, optionally on the lock screen too. Runs quietly in the system tray, checks on an interval you choose, backfills the days the computer was off and can keep only the last N days of images.
On KDE Plasma the wallpaper is set directly through the shell; on GNOME and other desktops through the XDG Wallpaper portal. System proxy settings are honoured and re-read before every download.

screenshot.caption: Status, current wallpaper and the latest images

description.p: First Linux release: KDE Plasma and GNOME wallpaper and lock screen, system proxy support, Flatpak packaging.
